'''Kestos Minor''' was a planet. It was represented directly in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Ivor Drake/Legends|Ivor Drake]].<ref name="DB" />

The planet was targeted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Kwymar Suppressions/Legends|Kwymar Suppressions]]. During the Imperial assault on the planet, [[Modigal Glave]] sustained facial damage.
